workflow.name: AI-Powered Recruitment Pipeline: CV Screening to Interview Scheduler
workflow.description: Automates candidate evaluation from CV submission to interview booking. Webhook receives CVs, stores in Airtable, AI extracts and assesses qualifications, filters candidates, generates personalized emails, schedules interviews, and notifies via Slack.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI GPT-5.1 used in CV extraction, assessment, and email generation

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

MODEL.description: LLM model name for AI processing

AIRTABLE_BASE_ID.description: Airtable base ID (mocked in this project)

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender email address for candidate outreach (mocked)

SLACK_CHANNEL_ID.description: Slack channel ID for recruitment notifications (mocked)

workflow_steps.name: Webhook - Receive CV
workflow_steps.description: Receive candidate CV submission via webhook POST with name, email, phone, cv_url, position

workflow_steps.name: Airtable - Store Candidate
workflow_steps.description: Store candidate record in Airtable with initial 'New Application' status

workflow_steps.name: Airtable - Get Job Requirements
workflow_steps.description: Fetch job requirements from Airtable matching the applied position

workflow_steps.name: HTTP Request - Download CV
workflow_steps.description: Download CV content from the provided URL

workflow_steps.name: AI - Extract CV Data
workflow_steps.description: Use GPT to extract structured data (skills, education, experience) from CV text

workflow_steps.name: Send Email - Candidate Outreach
workflow_steps.description: Send the personalized recruitment email to the candidate

workflow_steps.name: Filter - Interview Candidates
workflow_steps.description: Pass only candidates recommended for formal interview (not phone screen)

workflow_steps.name: Google Calendar - Schedule Interview
workflow_steps.description: Create a Google Calendar event for the interview, 3 days from now
